desc: Add a tidy and distinctive display with the 3-tier acrylic display ladder, designed to display desserts, accessories, and various pieces on multiple levels. Transparent and gradient design helps to see all pieces clearly, multiple items can be arranged in a small space without blocking each other. It can be used to display cupcakes, desserts, accessories, serving supplies and small decorations, making it suitable for home, kitchen and events. Multi-level design makes better use of display space, easy to place, remove and arrange pieces as needed. A practical option for display and organization, it can be used on dinners, kitchen countertops or at events to show the contents in a tidy and clear way.
